newsitem.title: GERMANY: Telekom CEO sees strong '97 profit growth.
newsitem.headline: Telekom CEO sees strong '97 profit growth.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG's chief executive Ron Sommer said on Wednesday his company posted operating profits of over six billion marks ($3.6 billion) in 1996 and forecast a profit expansion this year.

"Because the second half of 1996 developed better than the first half, we expect operating profits of more than six billion marks in 1996," Sommer said in the text of a speech prepared for delivery in Munich.
"And in 1997 we again expect strong growth in profits," he added.
Sommer was repeating a 1996 profit estimate which the company has already made.
Sales were estimated at over 63 billion marks last year. The company said recently that it expected sales also to rise this year.
Deutsche Telekom is expected to issue final 1996 results in May.
